# PgBouncer userlist.txt — managed by the entrypoint script
#
# SECURITY: This file is generated at container start from environment
# variables (DB_USER / DB_PASSWORD) by the edoburu/pgbouncer image's
# entrypoint. The actual file in the container is populated at runtime;
# this placeholder is bind-mounted and overwritten by the entrypoint.
#
# Format: "username" "md5-hashed-or-plain-password"
# Example (plain text, for local dev only):
#   "myapp" "supersecretpassword"
#
# In production the edoburu/pgbouncer image reads DB_USER and DB_PASSWORD
# environment variables and generates the md5 hash automatically.
# You do NOT need to edit this file manually when using the compose setup.
